protocol.question: Do mature reference-performance feedback and past market/current-intent jointly predict the conditional relative advantage of frozen absolute/relative trend experts across two already-seen stages?
protocol.data_role: SEEN_DEVELOPMENT_CHRONOLOGICAL_MECHANISM_SCREEN; 2024/2025 already observed, never new unseen/OOS or investment qualification
protocol.universe: Existing core5, retrospective limited survivor panel, not a new return-selected pool; full capital shared within each expert intent
protocol.expert_rules: SMA sign(completed_close-rolling200 mean), HOLD long, each200-close eligibility/.6 equal raw gross/.3 asset cap/existing30-return signed covariance10pct annual target downscale only. CSMOM exact original21d/weeklyK2 CORE5 golden, daily past risk. CASH0. No expert parameter tuning.
protocol.market_inputs: BTC8 past features+CORE5mean8+mom20/mom200 positive breadth+each4expert known gross/net/short_abs target intent. Current intent is not actual inventory.
protocol.feedback_inputs: Last1/4/12 complete fixed weekly slots of matured seven-day reference utility for each expert; actual label_available<=decision; no skipped missing slots, no fitted residual claims.
protocol.labels: Zero-entry capital10k expert follows daily causal intents7delayed intervals; actual proxy entry/internal-turnover/funding charged, execution-price endpoint valued without terminal exit. Reuse proxy_step. This is neither observedmark nor actual current-position switch utility. Availability waits nominal execution endpoint AND its source1m bar completion: decision+7d+120,000,001us; conservative1m extension for this explicit proxy only. No native-close maturity certification.
protocol.models: Shared multioutput sklearn StandardScaler+Ridge only; train-only fit, alpha10 fixed, no label scaling, CASH output exact0
protocol.fold_rules: One expanding daily fit per fold/input/fundingcase. Labels mature strictly before validation_start-7d, entire label purged+7d embargo. Weekly fixed calendar validation blocks, label_available<validation_end, no overlapping scored horizons; same exact dates/rows across3ablations. Missing registered validation inputs/labels fails, no deleting dates. All dates already seen; scaler/model never fit validation.
protocol.controls: Train-mean fixed expert; hindsight best single on validation as descriptive strong reference only; expanding mature past winner; fixed-parameter train-label-vector half-cycle-shift fit; random expert with identical evaluated model switch boundaries (negative-control diagnostic, not deployable schedule); oracle reference ceiling only. No averaging expert utility as shared wallet economics.
protocol.placebo: Exactly one circular shift of the entire4expert label vector byfloor(ntrain/2), within legally mature train rows, per primaryfit. Same alpha/scaler/folds. One switch-boundary matched random sequence per cell, seed1729. Twelve placebo fits total; no95percent significance claim.
protocol.success: Research continuation only: one input family must on both windows and both conditional fundingunits exceed validation best single byatleast5bp meanweekly referenceutility, capture>=15pct oracle-best-single gap, and beat fixedtrainmean, expandingpastwinner, shifted-labelfit and matchedswitchrandom. To claim joint-information increment, COMBINED must additionally exceed both other inputs in all4cells. If only simplerinput passes retain simplercandidate; native-wallet next step requires new prereg, never automatic investment adoption.
protocol.threshold_reason: 5bp is prior fixedweek net-calibration tolerance, minimum guard against an advantage within observed proxy error, not error bound;15pct opportunity capture makes further nativeaccount work worthwhile.
protocol.stop: Noalpha/horizon/feature/pool scan, no dropping weak cells, no extra model capacity or native wallets in this module. Train/validation divergence or inconsistent cells pauses exact recipe. If passes, independently preregister a real shared-wallet soft policy and controls; no utility->PnL conversion.
limitations: Reference-only prediction study, not cost-after actual shared-wallet returns/APR or proof of real-time regime alpha.
Daily train labels overlap; two funding interpretations share prices and do not create independent samples. Validation windows are already-seen development.
Single-week net calibration does not certify all expert paths or ranking fidelity; daily proxy omits native quantity buffer, risk/partialfills/liquidation and observedmark.
Reference CASH0 does not mean existing actual positions can close free; actual soft mixture must pay net target switching once and preserve risk reductions.
One shifted fit and random control per cell cannot establish placebo95pct or statistical significance.
Binance USD-M data/Bybit cost assumptions remain cross-venue proxy; funding unit uncertified and both scales required.
